name: Precision Peptide Company Inc
summary: The Precision Peptide Company Inc. manufactures and distributes plant-based patties and other food products in Canada. The company offers old fashioned ghee; energy gel; and plant-based patty; energy gel products, and munchie mix, as well as custom co-packing, private labelling, product development, and label, design, and regulatory services. It also provides peptide therapies for stress management, gut health, longevity, hair health, skin repair, and sleep health. It distributes its products through its websites, retail outlets, and wholesale networks. The company was formerly known as Pangea Wellness Inc. and changed its name to The Precision Peptide Company Inc. in March 2026. Pangea Wellness Inc. was incorporated in 2021 and is based in Vancouver, Canada.
